main.description: The private entries behind a scope's, organization's, team's or package's commitments that the caller may see: their own; every entry of a scope, its organization's members and teams, and its packages for the scope's owners; a team's for its maintainers; and a package's for its owners.

account.description: A scope or a package on this registry.

team.description: With an organization: one of its teams, in place of the scope's maintainers.

members.description: With an organization: its members, in place of the scope's maintainers.
